about: Each car the player can have. meshes -> everrail_assets ids. length_m = EverRail size x world_scale (track sheet), measured from the decoded mesh bounds. layout = an EverRail blueprint (layouts sheet) the car is assembled from; its meshes are then placed with that layout's SM_GlazeEngine transform. start_count = cars the stalled train already has when found (the first wagon is the player's base). Power add-ons are not carriages: 7 Days' own Generator Bank and Battery Bank blocks built in a wagon room, and solar cells installed on the roof (power_sources).

rows.unlock: found stalled on the ring near spawn
comes with the locomotive; more from a workbench. Its side door steps you off to the ground while the train is stopped
